description: Held SEEK faculty (affordance): the self (controllable region) moves death-gated toward the target cell (tgt_r,tgt_c) on its own node, via argmax over the learned control basis resp_<A>. A new faculty is a small minted PRODUCER that writes (tgt_r,tgt_c); SEEK is reused unchanged (compose via the shared attr). Host-provided primitive. Generated by scripts/gen_seek_primitive_seed.py.

microtheory.name: seek_primitive
microtheory.description: move toward self.tgt; producers feed the target

rules.name: seek_to_target
rules.comment: death-gated argmax over resp_<A> toward (self.tgt_r,self.tgt_c); fires only when a producer has set tgt_set>0.5, so SEEK is inert until a faculty feeds it a target.
